c1-19-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Comparing Pay
c1-19-01.scenario: You and a friend read a report about pay and education in towns and villages.
c1-19-01.prompt: Say that graduates' pay is higher than the average wage, and that towns and villages differ in education.
cues: Compare graduates' pay with the average wage
Say where the difference is big
c1-19-01.target: A diplomások fizetése az átlagkereset viszonylatában még mindig magasabb. Az iskolázottság tekintetében nagy a különbség a városok és a falvak között.
c1-19-01.english: Graduates' pay is still higher in relation to the average wage. With regard to education there is a big difference between towns and villages.
c1-19-01.canDo: I can compare groups and figures (*arányában*, *viszonylatában*, *tekintetében*).

c1-19-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Nobles Did
c1-19-02.scenario: You and a friend read a history text about the nobility and the land.
c1-19-02.prompt: Say what the state did after dividing the land, and what many noble families did after losing their wealth.
cues: Say what the noble families did
c1-19-02.target: A földet felosztva az állam átalakította a falusi társadalmat. A vagyonukat elveszítve sok nemesi család állami hivatalba ment.
c1-19-02.english: Having divided the land, the state transformed village society. Having lost their wealth, many noble families went into state office.
c1-19-02.canDo: I can say what someone did first with a *-va/-ve* participle (*A földet felosztva az állam átalakította …*).

c1-19-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Leaving Poverty
c1-19-03.scenario: You and a friend talk about a report on poor villages.
c1-19-03.prompt: Say that very few students get into university from these villages, and that people there can live only from casual work.
cues: Say how few students get in
c1-19-03.target: Ezekben a falvakban mindössze néhány diák jut be az egyetemre. Az emberek csupán alkalmi munkából tudnak megélni.
c1-19-03.english: In these villages merely a few students get into university. People can live only from casual work.
c1-19-03.canDo: I can stress how small a number is (*mindössze*, *csupán*).

c1-19-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Early Selection
c1-19-04.scenario: You and a friend talk about a text on school selection and cultural capital.
c1-19-04.prompt: Say that early selection causes dropout and increases differences, and that a lack of cultural capital hinders advancement.
cues: Say what the lack of cultural capital does
c1-19-04.target: A korai szelekció lemorzsolódást okoz, növelve a társadalmi különbségeket. A kulturális tőke hiánya gátolja az előrejutást.
c1-19-04.english: Early selection causes dropout, increasing social differences. The lack of cultural capital hinders advancement.
c1-19-04.canDo: I can name a result with a participle (*maga után vonva*, *eredményezve*, *növelve*).

c1-19-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Erdei's Two Worlds
c1-19-05.scenario: You and a friend talk about the short text about Erdei Ferenc.
c1-19-05.prompt: Say that the difference between the two social worlds grew considerably, and name the first of the two worlds.
cues: Say how much the difference grew
c1-19-05.target: A két társadalmi világ között a különbség számottevően nőtt. Az egyik a történelmi-nemzeti társadalom volt.
c1-19-05.english: The difference between the two social worlds grew considerably. One of them was the historical-national society.
c1-19-05.canDo: I can say how big a change is with a scalar adverb (*számottevően*, *drasztikusan*, *elhanyagolható mértékben*).

c1-19-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Talking About Inequality
c1-19-consolidation.scenario: You and a friend talk about what you read in this unit.
c1-19-consolidation.prompt: Say that the difference between towns and villages grew considerably, and that very few students from poor villages get into university.
cues: Say how few students get in
c1-19-consolidation.target: A különbség a városok és a falvak között számottevően nőtt. Mindössze néhány diák jut be az egyetemre a szegény falvakból.
c1-19-consolidation.english: The difference between towns and villages has grown considerably. Merely a few students from poor villages get into university.
c1-19-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about social layers, inequality and mobility in Hungarian.
